description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ModelWidget which serves as a base for widget model classes in the OFBiz framework. It includes properties for widget attributes, methods for accepting visitors, retrieving metadata (name, system ID, location), boundary comment control, and boundary display type.

classes.name: ModelWidget
classes.description: An abstract class representing a widget model with core properties (name, systemId, location) and behaviors (accepting visitors, boundary comment management).

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to accept a visitor object for processing the widget.

methods.name: getSystemId
methods.description: Returns the URL or identifier of where the widget was defined.

methods.name: getStartColumn
methods.description: Returns the column number where the widget is defined in its XML.

methods.name: getStartLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the widget is defined.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the widget by traversing it with a visitor.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns the name used in boundary comments; defaults to widget's name.

methods.name: widgetBoundaryCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Static method to determine if boundary comments are enabled based on properties and context.

methods.name: widgetNamedBorderType
methods.description: Static method to get the border display type setting for development purposes.
